summary: Modern, concise, null-safe language serving as Google's premier standard for Android development and modern JVM backends.

rows.means: read-only immutable reference / reassignable mutable variable
rows.consequence: Prefer val by default. Immutable references prevent side-effect bugs across multithreaded Android apps.

rows.code:
fun name(param: Type): ReturnType { ... }
fun double(x: Int) = x * 2
rows.consequence: A function whose body is a single expression can drop the braces and the return, as the second form shows.

rows.code: Nullable types: String? vs non-null String
rows.means: type system distinguishes between nullable and non-nullable references
rows.consequence: The compiler prevents calling methods on String? directly, eliminating the billion-dollar NullPointerException at build time.

rows.means: evaluates property access only if reference is non-null
rows.consequence: Returns null safely if user or profile is null rather than throwing an exception.

rows.means: provides fallback value if left-hand expression is null
rows.consequence: The fallback makes the result non-null, so the type after the operator has no question mark and the compiler stops asking about it.

rows.code: data class User(val id: Int, val name: String)
rows.consequence: Automatically generates equals(), hashCode(), toString(), componentN() destructuring, and copy() methods.
Can evaluate expressions, type checks, and ranges; compiler checks that all enum or sealed class branches are handled.

rows.means: thread-safe singleton declaration / static class members
rows.consequence: object DatabaseManager creates a lazy thread-safe singleton instance on first access without boilerplate.

rows.means: adds methods to existing classes without inheritance
rows.consequence: Allows extending Android framework classes (e.g. View.hide()) cleanly while maintaining full static typing.

rows.code: Smart cast: if (x is String) { x.length }
rows.means: compiler automatically casts variable to target type after check
rows.consequence: Eliminates explicit casting (as String); once checked with is, the compiler knows the exact type inside that branch.
A suspending function pauses without blocking the thread underneath it, which is what keeps an interface responsive while work is in flight.

rows.means: restricted class hierarchies representing finite state variants
rows.consequence: The compiler knows the whole set of variants, so a when over them can be checked for exhaustiveness and a new state cannot be forgotten at one of the places that handles them.
